The registry reports no results for this search. With organization name "Mayo Clinic*", NPI type Organization, city Rochester and state MN, it shows the error "No matching records found."

I ran the exact search several times and got the same result each time. Dropping the city gave the same error, and so did the shorter "Mayo*". The wildcard form seems to return nothing on this site. Without the asterisk, "Mayo Clinic" returns a results page headed "Results: 1 - 50", so entries do exist. That page doesn't show a total count, and I didn't count past the first page.
